name: herdr
description: Bots see the coding agents herdr runs, here and on its saved machines, send them work, start new ones, press keys in them, and hear back when one is done. herdr's own screen opens in the page, and you tag an agent in a chat with @herdr:.

settings.name: kinds
settings.description: The agents bots may start, comma-separated

settings.name: hours
settings.description: The most hours fxbot waits for an agent's answer, 1 to 24

settings.name: lines
settings.description: How many of an agent's last lines its answer carries, 20 to 400

settings.name: watches
settings.description: The most prompts waiting for an answer at once, 1 to 16

settings.name: sync
settings.description: How often, in seconds, the list of agents for @herdr: tags syncs, 30 to 3600

settings.name: door
settings.description: The door's socket, as fxbot sees it: sudo fxbot herdr on opens it

settings.name: herdr
settings.description: herdr's command, for a checkout run by herdr's own user
